test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain duration of time, a sum become 2 times itself at the rate of 5% per annum simple interest. What will be the rate of interest if the same sum becomes 5 times itself in the same duration?
solution:
**Given:**

Sum becomes 2 times at 5% p.a rate 

At same time time the same sum becomes 5 times.

**Concept used:**

S.I = P × R × T/100

**Calculations:**

According to question,

P × 5 × T/100 = P

⇒ T = 20 years

Now, P × R × T/100 = 4P

⇒ P × R × 20/100 = 4P

⇒ R = 4 × 5 = 20%

**Hence, The Required value is 20%.**
